name: IssueLabel
statusNote: IssueLabel's docs file says alpha, but it is exported only from @primer/react/experimental and has no primer.style page; treat the API as unstable. It is the newer, token-driven replacement for coloured labels; IssueLabelToken (see token) remains the removable form.
summary: A filled pill for a GitHub issue label in one of 19 named label hues, or in an arbitrary hex colour with black or white text. Choose it for user-defined labels; choose Label for fixed metadata and Token or IssueLabelToken when the label is removable.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: A named label hue; ignored when fillColor is set.

inputs.name: fillColor
inputs.description: A #hex background; overrides variant and derives black or white text.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Renders the label as a button.

inputs.name: href
inputs.description: Renders the label as a link (takes precedence over onClick).

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: A full-radius filled pill at least 20px tall with 8px side padding, no border, and a transparent 1px inset ring reserved for a future high-contrast border.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.description: Small body text, semibold, at the small body line height, never wrapping.

variants.description: variant = <hue> (gray by default): fill --label-<hue>-bgColor-rest, text --label-<hue>-fgColor-rest, with -hover and -active tokens when interactive. All 19 hues have the same six tokens.
fillColor = #rrggbb: the fill is that colour exactly and the text is black or white by WCAG relative luminance; no hover or press change (see notes).
onClick: hover and press colours, pointer cursor, focus ring.
href: as button, with no underline.

layout.text: Minimum height --base-size-20 (20px); side padding --base-size-8 (8px), no vertical padding; content centred vertically; width hugs the text, which never wraps.
No border; a --boxShadow-thin inset ring in transparent sits where a high-contrast border will go, full radius.

states.text: Named: --label-<hue>-bgColor-rest fill, --label-<hue>-fgColor-rest text. Hex: the fillColor fill and its readable text colour.
Button or link only: --label-<hue>-bgColor-hover fill and --label-<hue>-fgColor-hover text, pointer cursor.
Button or link only: --label-<hue>-bgColor-active fill and --label-<hue>-fgColor-active text.
Button or link with keyboard focus: a 2px solid --focus-outline-color outline offset 2px outside the pill (not the usual -2px inside), and no shadow.

behaviour.text: The element is chosen by props: an explicit as wins, then href makes a link, then onClick makes a button (type button), else a span.

Hex text colour (color2k 2.0.3 readableColor): linearise each sRGB channel c/255 as c/12.92 when c <= 0.04045 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4; luminance Y = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B; text is #000 when Y > 0.179, else #fff. The rule is theme-independent.

A hex label sets no data-variant; the module then points its colour variables at --label-bgColor-light-rest, --label-fgColor-dark and similar names by colour mode, but nothing defines those names, and the inline fill and text colour win regardless.

accessibility.role: none (a span); button with onClick; link with href
keyboard: Tab focuses a button or link label.
Enter activates; Space also activates a button.
semantics: The name is the label text; the colour carries no meaning on its own.

notes.text: A hex label (fillColor) has no hover or press feedback even as a button or link: its fill and text are inline styles, which outrank the module's :hover and :active rules, and the variables those rules read are undefined for it.

Two different algorithms colour arbitrary labels in Primer: IssueLabel (this) fills with the hex and picks black or white by WCAG luminance in every theme; IssueLabelToken derives tinted fills, borders and text per light or dark theme from perceived lightness (token spec). Do not mix them.
Every hue also has a --label-<hue>-borderColor token; IssueLabel does not read it (its ring is transparent).

color2k is not vendored; the readable-colour algorithm above was read from color2k 2.0.3 on unpkg (the vendored @primer/primitives package.json pins ^2.0.3; Primer React's own pin is not vendored). A native build implements it directly.
Long names never wrap or truncate (white-space nowrap, no max-width); a native build that needs a bound adds its own ellipsis.
